what: Server-side request forgery matrix against the real admission gate, not a mock.
method: AdmissionGate.decide(url, rebag manifest, purpose=page_fetch). The gate resolves a hostname and judges the resolved address, so encoded forms are caught by resolution rather than by pattern.
reading: Every private and loopback form tested is refused, including the cloud metadata endpoint 169.254.169.254, IPv6 ::1, all three RFC1918 ranges, and the decimal, hex and short-form encodings of 127.0.0.1. The gate reports which address it resolved, so the refusal is auditable.
correction: An earlier claim in this session that the fetch path carried no private-range or metadata guard was wrong. It was drawn from _is_public_hostname in sources/platform.py, which only gates Shopify origin inference. The real guard is in sources/admission.py and is comprehensive. Recorded because the wrong claim was stated to the operator.
not_a_finding: 0177.0.0.1 is admitted, and that is correct: this resolver maps it to the public address 177.0.0.1, not to loopback.
